name: Takanabe (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Takanabe town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar enclosing a stylised device, with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Takanabe, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1966.

features.role: Takanabe town emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar enclosing a stylised device, with a pointed top
